test_title: PYST 29: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select ‘No error’.

It was her who represented our school in the interschool debate competition.
solution:
The erroneous part is **"It was her"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the usage of "her" is incorrect instead of this we need to use "she"
 
• In the given sentence, "who" is a subject pronoun that takes a subjective pronoun as an antecedent since "it" is a dummy subject, not a real subject. Hence, we need to use a subjective case of a pronoun instead of an objective case.

**So the correct sentence is-** *It was **she who** represented our school in the interschool debate competition.*
